questions.prompt: In a <script setup> SFC, what do you need to do to use a child component in the template?

options.text: Register it in a components: option
Import it in <script setup> — that's enough
Call app.component() globally
Nothing; all components are global

questions.explanation: With <script setup>, importing a component registers it locally, so you can use its tag directly without a components: option.

questions.prompt: What does <script setup> expose to the template?

options.text: Only refs
Every top-level binding (refs, functions, computeds, imported components), with no return statement
Nothing — you must return values
Only functions named render

questions.explanation: All top-level bindings declared in <script setup> are automatically available to the template; there is no return statement.

questions.prompt: Does a Vue 3 component template require a single root element?

options.text: Yes, always
No — Vue 3 supports multiple root nodes (fragments)
Only in the Options API
Only if it has styles

questions.explanation: Vue 3 allows multiple root elements in a template, so a single wrapper element is optional.

questions.prompt: By convention, Vue component names are written in ______Case (e.g. UserCard). (one word, the case name)
questions.explanation: Components are named in PascalCase, matching the imported name and typically the file name.

questions.prompt: Which statements about components are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: Each use of a component is an independent instance with its own state
Components let you reuse UI and logic
A child component works in <script setup> without being imported
Apps are typically built as a tree of components

questions.explanation: Components are reusable, each instance is independent, and apps are trees of them. In <script setup>, a child MUST be imported to be used.

questions.prompt: How does a parent pass data down to a child component?

options.text: Through props (attributes on the component tag)
By modifying the child's internal state directly
Through the URL only
It cannot pass data down

questions.explanation: Parents pass data to children via props — custom attributes on the component tag (covered in depth in the next lesson).
